purpose: Next.js server actions that translate admin dashboard forms into SHRESTA-BE mutations.
ownedConcepts: Bulk asset category/subcategory assignment request action
Category family/product type/attribute/filter/tax/styling change request submissions
businessRules: Each mutating form must submit an idempotencyKey field.
Actions forward the idempotency key to SHRESTA-BE instead of generating hidden browser state.
Actions revalidate affected admin routes after successful mutation.
JSON metadata/rules inputs must parse to JSON objects before being sent to the backend.
Asset actions must forward categoryProductTypeKey with categoryFamilyKey so UI-visible images can be bound to backend taxonomy subcategories.
Asset tag form values are validated against the shared 40-character/16-tag uppercase token contract before uploads or reviewable metadata changes are submitted.

Image replacement is an approved binary apply path because the file itself cannot be safely carried through JSON review payloads; the backend still enforces admin role, idempotency, row locking, versioning, and KV invalidation.
Create/update/archive/delete admin form submissions create reviewable change requests before records are changed or removed.
Approval execution is backend-owned; frontend actions only submit requests or reviewer decisions.
